scientific_integrity: All algebraic identities and optimization signs are reproducible from explicit 16-state transition rates. Independent external review has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact four-site single-defect near-equilibrium current at half-filled reservoirs; not a full finite-bias or thermodynamic-limit theorem. Algebraic derivation supported by a standalone exact finite-state checker.
title: Sharp single-trap rectification and its unique susceptibility optimum in a four-site exclusion channel
